# Sample outputs (generated by demo.py)

## Verified Local API Test Run

The following results were captured from the local FastAPI application in
offline mode. Responses below are representative excerpts where explicitly
marked; they are not complete payloads.

### `GET /health`

Response excerpt:

```json
{"ok": true, "llm": "rule-based-offline"}
```

This confirms that the application selected the deterministic offline adapter.

### `POST /chat` — exact patient retrieval with a similar-name warning

Request:

```json
{
  "session_id": "demo-session-1",
  "text": "Open Priya Nair's latest OPG report",
  "patient_id": null
}
```

The request successfully retrieved report `R-1002`, dated `2026-09-18`.
The response included a warning about the similar-sounding patient Priya Nayar
and requested DOB verification.

### `POST /chat` — conversational follow-up

Request:

```json
{"session_id": "demo-session-1", "text": "Summarize her report"}
```

The response returned a report-grounded summary using the previous conversation
context rather than requiring the patient name again.

### `POST /dictate` — structured draft

Request:

```json
{
  "session_id": "demo-session-1",
  "transcript": "Lower right third molar is horizontally impacted.",
  "patient_id": "P001"
}
```

The response created a structured draft with status
`DRAFT_REQUIRES_CLINICIAN_REVIEW`, `clinician_reviewed: false`, evidence from
the supplied transcript, and an explicit review requirement.

### `GET /drafts/{draft_id}`

The created draft was retrieved successfully using draft ID `D-05CCE223`.
Draft IDs are generated dynamically, so a different ID is expected on another
run.

### `PUT /drafts/{draft_id}`

The draft was successfully updated through `PUT /drafts/{draft_id}`. The
updated draft remains subject to clinician review.

### `POST /drafts/{draft_id}/finalize` — review guard

Request body:

```json
{"clinician_reviewed": false}
```

The request was rejected with:

```json
{"detail": "Clinician review is required before finalization."}
```

This rejection demonstrates the intended safety guard: a draft cannot be
finalized until a clinician explicitly confirms review.
